Package Photos.model

Class User

java.lang.Object
Photos.model.User
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<User>
public class User extends Object implements Serializable, Comparable<User>
Represents a non-admin user. Stores albums, photos, and tag types. Supports creating, deleting, and renaming albums, as well as searching photos by date range or tag-value pairs.
